svg.title: Store it going forward, multiply it coming back
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Store it going forward, multiply it coming back” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A six-node computation graph running left to right in blue from x through a matmul giving z1 equals 0.6 and 0.1, a ReLU, a second matmul giving z2 equals 0.7, a sigmoid giving 0.6682 and a binary cross-entropy giving loss 0.4032, with an amber dashed cached box under each intermediate, and five numbered green arrows running right to left underneath carrying the local derivatives, with the sigmoid-plus-cross-entropy simplification to y-hat minus y equals -0.3318 circled and a crossed-out naive recompute-per-weight alternative.
svg.text: Store it going forward, multiply it coming back
draw it from memory, then compare
